[
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as lesions on the face (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and on the genitalia.",
  "The consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100 % (21/21).",
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness and for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary tumor and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "The criteria driving the 4‑point score are pigment_network (atypical, 2 points), dots_and_globules (irregular, 1 point), and regression_structures (combinations, 1 point).",
  "Pigment_network, dots_and_globules, and regression_structures are major or minor features that contribute to melanoma suspicion.",
  "On the image, an atypical pigment network appears as irregular meshes and thickened lines.",
  "On the image, irregularly distributed dots or globules should be identified.",
  "On the image, combinations of regression structures such as white scar‑like areas and blue peppering should be identified.",
  "These features are scoring positive and are key to the elevated 7‑point score."
]
